name: ESO 379-G007 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 379-G007, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso379g007-hubble
story: A small, irregular galaxy on the outskirts of the Centaurus A group. Hubble picked out its individual stars so astronomers could measure its distance from the brightest red giants.

claims.text: ESO 379-G007 is a dwarf irregular galaxy
ESO 379-G007 is also known as HIPASS J1154-33
ESO 379-G007 lies on the outskirts of the Cen A (Centaurus A) group
ESO379-007 is a galaxy target of Hubble program 12546 at RA 11h54m43.2s, Dec -33 33 32 (matches the pointing)
The program measures distances to nearby galaxies from the tip of the red giant branch, resolving individual stars
